title: your life as Radahn
fullText: congratulations y radon the star Scourge what's a star scour you ask well imagine if a medieval war God and a literal asteroid had a baby that's you you're bigger than most houses swing weapons that should legally count as small Bridges and oh yeah you personally told the Stars to sit down and shut up but before you became the cosmic bodybuilder of the lands between you were just a kid a really big kid born to ragon of the golden order and rala queen of the full moon you should have had a perfect child childhood key word should have because well Dad left for milk and never came back see ragon and all his Divine wisdom took one look at your family and said actually I think I'll go be the consort of a literal God instead and just like that he pieced out to Mary Queen ma leaving your mom in a downward spiral of magical depression so your childhood a little rough but nothing you couldn't handle buddy I think while other kids were learning magic or Royal etiquette you were learning the first hard truth of life is the only thing that matters if you weren't strong enough people left and so you did what any emotionally neglected demigod would do you bulked up like a final boss from a young age you trained your body like it was a religious experience while your siblings were busy playing Magic chess or learning politics you were out in the field swinging swords bigger than most horses you weren't just training to be strong you were training to be the strongest then came Leonard yes the horse see there was one problem with your little obsession with strength you got too damn big no normal Steed could carry you so logically you had two options number one get a bigger horse number two learn gravity magic so you wouldn't crush the tiny horse you already had naturally you picked option two enter the alabaster Lords ancient alien beings who literally fell out of the sky one day and decided yeah we live here now these weren't your average Wizards throwing Fireballs in bathrooms these guys could straight up ignore gravity because why not and so you learn from them bending the laws of physics itself not for war not for knowledge but for Leonard which means your First Act of reality defying power wasn't crushing enemies or Moving Mountains it was horse-based ergonomics and with that you weren't just a big dude with a sword anymore you were radon the walking Extinction event so you've got the muscles you've got the gravity magic you've got Leonard the best boy what's next world domination obviously while demigods were busy arguing over philosophy or finger related Cults you had a simpler goal become the strongest warrior in history and spoiler alert you did you weren't just a warrior you were a oneman natural disaster when you weren't crushing enemies under sheer muscle mass you were calling down meteors just because you could your Battlefield strategy be so overwhelmingly powerful that strategy doesn't matter while other generals were drawing up plans and discussing Logistics you were out there wiping out Army by by yourself and the best part your men loved you for it unlike certain other demigods godric you didn't rule through fear you rule through respect but even with your ridiculous strength you weren't satisfied you needed something bigger and then one day you looked up at the night sky and thought what if I sto those so you did forever well almost forever but we'll get to that you flexed so hard that the cosmic order of the universe froze in place you didn't just conquer the Battlefield you conquered fate did this also make you The Greatest Warrior in history yes did it also put a giant Cosmic Target on your back absolutely because when Queen ma shattered the Elden ring the world plunged into chaos and if you think a bunch of power hungry demigods were going to let you keep a monopoly on the Stars you've got another thing coming welcome to the shattering things are about to get messy so maica shattered the Elden ring and naturally every demigod decided that meant it was go time the shadowing wasn't just a war it was a family feud on steroids your siblings your half siblings your step siblings and probably a few people who were just really into grafting all of them wanted a piece of the Elden ring and then there was you you didn't care about politics you weren't here to make alliances or declare yourself Elden Lord you were here to fight and fight you did then melenia showed up she wasn't here for power or a throne she was here because Michela sent her and when you fought the world broke two legends clashed and the world paid the price the sky burned the Earth crumbled Army stopped fighting just to watch until she cheated melenia Unleashed her Scarlet rot as a final worldbe damned effort to kill you but it didn't kill you it did something much worse you lost not quickly not cleanly the Scarlet rot unmade you your flesh decayed your mind fractured your hunger became unbearable and yet you lived somehow your body refused to die your instincts took over and you became a beast staggering through the Wasteland that used to be your kingdom but the one thing you didn't forget Leonard the world saw you as a Mindless horror so they gave you one final gift a festival most people when they lose their minds get locked in a basement or politely escorted Into Obscurity but since you're not like other gods the people of lands between looked at you a rampaging disease ridden demigod and thought what if we made this a party and so they did the Festival of death was n just a battle it was a spectacle trumpets fireworks poets writing Odes Warriors traveling across the world for the privilege of being pulped by you a grand joyous event where everyone got together to see who could land the killing blow on kid's biggest mistake and if you were going to die it wasn't going to be because you tripped over Leonard and broke your neck it was going to be in combat then the tarnished arrive you threw everything at them swords magic your actual body because if you were going down you were taking someone with you and when you fell the Stars moved again your story ended kind of you think after a legendry warrior goes out in a blaze of glory they'd get to rest maybe kick back in the afterlife reminisce about the good old days or at least haunt some ruins in peace but no because the moment you finally got some peace Mela happened turns out your death wasn't the end of your story it was just another step in mela's 4D chess game because your broon half brother just can't let things go see while everyone else was celebrating the fact that the stars were moving again Mela was busy cooking up his latest Obsession something about remaking the world in his perfect little image and apparently step one of that plan was bringing you back why well there are a few theories maybe he needs your power for the brainwash nightmare Utopia he's cooking up maybe he just refuses to accept losing or maybe just maybe he's been obsessed with making you his consort since day one yep even made a one vow about it typical sibling gaslighting Behavior I guess see back in the day Mela looked at you and thought yep that's husband material but when you refused to join his perfect little cult he sent melenia to convince you we all know how that turned out a lot of rot destruction and a one-way ticket to Mindless cannibalism but even after all that Mela still won't take the hint so while the world moved on he was busy dragging your soul back into play because if he couldn't have you then he'd just rebuild you now if you want to know just how far this little Johan leebert wannabe is willing to go for control check out my other video on him for now all you need to know is that you've been revived recycled and repurposed into something far worse your body a grotesque Fusion of yourself and mogs corpse because nothing says love like stitching your crush into your dead half brother do two halves make a hole in this case your new title mela's promised consort which is a bold claim considering you never agreed to it but considering this is the same guy who brainwashed an entire blood cult into worshiping him your consent was never really part of the equation now instead of being kids or fate itself's biggest problem you're mela's personal Frankenstein experiment and if history has taught you anything it's that when outer gods and Force transformations are involved things never end well so now you're back as whatever this is some horrible Fusion of yourself MOG and mela's questionable Life Choices maybe you fight to break free maybe you fight because Mela told you to maybe you fight because at this point it's just muscle memory but one thing's for sure someone's getting their ass kicked and when the tarnished finally puts you down for the second time you think that's it that you finally get some peace but let's be real this is a from software game you're probably coming back in another DLC maybe next time they'll staple more body parts onto you maybe Mela will finally upgrade you to radon 3.0 now comes with wings or maybe just maybe you'll actually get some r but probably not anyway GG well played now go touch some Grace
